chloride.options.clouds.height.title: Altura de Nubes
chloride.options.clouds.height.desc:
Alcanza las nubes, o que ellas te alcancen a ti.
Configura que tan alto se posicionan las nubes
chloride.options.culling.entity.title: Activar para Entidades
chloride.options.culling.entity.desc: Si se activa, Las entidades fuera del rango configurado no se renderizaran
chloride.options.culling.entity.distance: Oculta y no actualiza las entidades fuera de rango en el cliente. Incrementa bastante el rendimiento, especialmente en granjas de animales.
Oculta y no actualiza las entidades fuera de tu altura en el cliente, Incrementa bastante el rendimiento fuera de las cuevas. Esto deberia de configurarse a un valor inferior al rango horizontal
chloride.options.culling.tiles.title: Activar para Entidades de Bloques
chloride.options.culling.tiles.desc: Si se activa, Las entidades de bloque fuera del rango configurado no se renderizaran
chloride.options.culling.tile.distance.h: Oculta y no actualiza las entidades de bloques fuera de rango en el cliente. Incrementa bastante el rendimiento, especialmente en fabricas de otros mods.
chloride.options.culling.tile.distance.v: Oculta y no actualiza las entidades de bloques fuera de tu altura en el cliente, Incrementa bastante el rendimiento fuera de las cuevas si tienes minadoras automaticas. Esto deberia de configurarse a un valor inferior al rango horizontal.
chloride.options.darkness.mode.title: Modo de oscuridad
chloride.options.darkness.mode.desc:
Has que tu mundo sea envuelto en total oscuridad, no afecta a la iluminacion de dia o de las antorchas.
Controla que tan oscuro se considera "total oscuridad"
chloride.options.darkness.others.title: Activar en otras dimensiones
chloride.options.darkness.others.desc:
Si se activa, se aplicara la oscuridad en las demas dimensiones

[AVISO] Esta opcion se eliminara pronto en favor de una whitelist
chloride.options.darkness.overworld.desc: Si se activa, se aplicara la oscuridad en la Superficie.
chloride.options.darkness.noskylight.des: Si se activa, se aplicara la oscuridad en Dimensiones sin Cielo
chloride.options.darkness.nether.title: Activar en el Nether
chloride.options.darkness.nether.desc: Si se activa, se aplicara la oscuridad en el Nether
chloride.options.darkness.nether.brightn: Brillo de Niebla en el Nether
Configura el brillo de la niebla en el nether si la oscuridad se activa en el Nether
chloride.options.darkness.end.title: Activar en el End
chloride.options.darkness.end.desc: Si se activa, se aplicara la oscuridad en el End.
chloride.options.darkness.end.brightness: Configure fog brightness in the End when darkness is enabled.
chloride.options.darkness.blocklightonly: If enabled, Disables sky, fog and moon brightness, making blocks as a only source of light
chloride.options.darkness.moonphase.desc: Si se activa, la oscuridad se vera afectada por las fases lunares
chloride.options.darkness.moonphase.fres: Configure brightness on a new moon, or minimal bright level on black moon phase
chloride.options.darkness.moonphase.full: Configure brightness on a full moon, or maximum bright level on black moon phase
chloride.options.displayfps.title: Mostrar FPS
chloride.options.displayfps.desc: Mostrar los FPS. Modo avanzado muestra la cantidad mas baja de FPS, en unos 15 segundos de FPS promedio, util para evaluar el rendimiento.
chloride.options.displayfps.gravity.desc: Esquina en la que se posicionara el texto
chloride.options.displayfps.system.title: Mostrar Metricas
chloride.options.displayfps.system.desc: Mostrar uso de memoria y GPU al lado del contador de FPS
chloride.options.displayfps.margin.title: Margen del Texto
chloride.options.displayfps.margin.desc: Espacio entre la esquina y el texto
chloride.options.displayfps.shadow.title: Sombra cuadrada
chloride.options.displayfps.shadow.desc: Agrega una sombra cuadrada debajo del contador de FPS, al puro estilo del F3
chloride.options.dynlights.tiles.title: Activar en Entidades de Bloques
chloride.options.dynlights.tiles.desc:
If enabled, dynamic lighting will be showed on tile entities (furnaces, modded machines, etc).

This can drastically increase the amount of lighting updates, even when you're not around furnaces
chloride.options.dynlights.entities.desc:
If enabled, dynamic lighting will be showed on entities (dropped items, mobs, etc).

This can drastically increase the amount of lighting updates, even when you're not holding a torch.
chloride.options.dynlights.speed.title: Velocidad de actualizacion
chloride.options.dynlights.speed.desc:
Controla que tan rapido se realizaran las actualizaciones.

El calculo puede consumir recursos, por lo que tenerlo en bajas velocidades aumenta el rendimiento
chloride.options.fadein.title: Chunk Fade In Quality
chloride.options.fadein.desc: Controls how fast chunks fade in. No performance hit, Fancy simply takes longer, but looks a bit cooler. Currently not working
chloride.options.fastchest.title: Activar Cofres Rapidos
chloride.options.fastchest.desc:
Si se activa, remplazara los cofres con un modelo estatico, como si fuera un bloque. Elimina la animacion del cofre, pero te da mas FPS en salas de cofre

Esta opcion no tiene efecto cuando Create (Flywheel) esta instalado
chloride.options.fastbeds.title: Activar Camas rapidas
chloride.options.fastbeds.desc: Si se activa, remplazara las camas con un bloque estatico, somo si se fuera un bloque. Incrementa el rendimiento y te permite utilizar modelos mas complejos en resource packs
chloride.options.fog.title: Mostrar Niebla
chloride.options.fog.desc: Si se desactiva, la niebla no se mostrara en la superficie
chloride.options.fontshadow.title: Sombra en los textos
chloride.options.fontshadow.desc:
Si se desactiva, los textos dejaran de renderizar sombras.
Incrementa el rendimiento en menus con mucho texto, como el BetterF3
chloride.options.jei.title: Ocultar JEI/REI/EMI hasta buscar
chloride.options.jei.desc: Si se desactiva, los items en el JEI/REI/EMI se ocultan hasta que busques algo. Escribe un espacio para buscar cualquier cosa
chloride.options.screen.title: Pantalla Completa
chloride.options.screen.desc:
Ventana - el juego se mostrara en una ventana.
Sin Bordes - el juego se pondra en pantalla completa pero en modo ventana, y bloqueado a los hercios de tu sistema, pero te deja cambiar de ventanas mas rapido.
Pantalla Completa - el juego se mostrara en pantalla completa nativamente
chloride.options.others.borderless.attac:
Configura como la pantalla completa sin bordes se aplica al F11

ADJUNTAR - Agrega la opcion entre modo ventana y pantalla completa
REMPLAZAR - Cambia la pantalla completa vanilla por la sin bordes
APAGADO - Conserva el comportamiento vanilla
chloride.options.others.languagescreen.f: Si se activa, el menu del idioma solo actualizara el lenguage en lugar de actualizar todos los resources, un 99.9% extra de eficiencia
chloride.options.clouds.height.title: Cloud Height
chloride.options.clouds.height.desc:
Raises cloud height.
Configure the height of the clouds
chloride.options.nametag.disable_renderi:
Do not show me your name!
Disables nametag rendering for players and entities
chloride.options.displayfps.title: Display FPS
chloride.options.displayfps.desc: Displays the current FPS. Advanced mode also displays minimum FPS, as well as 15 second average FPS, useful for judging performance.
chloride.options.displayfps.gravity.desc: Corner position of the FPS display
chloride.options.displayfps.system.title: Display Metrics
chloride.options.displayfps.system.desc: Displays memory usage and GPU usage beside FPS counter
chloride.options.displayfps.margin.title: Text Margin
chloride.options.displayfps.shadow.title: Use Text Shadow Box
chloride.options.displayfps.shadow.desc: Add a Shadow box onto FPS Display, at the pure style of F3
chloride.options.culling.entity.title: Use Max Entity Distance
chloride.options.culling.entity.desc: If enabled, Entities will be hidden based on configured distance limit
chloride.options.culling.entity.distance: Hides and does not tick entities beyond this many blocks. Huge performance increase, especially around modded farms.
Hides and does not tick entities underneath this many blocks, improving performance above caves. This should ideally be set lower than the horizontal distance.
chloride.options.culling.monster.title: Use Max Monster Distance
chloride.options.culling.monster.desc: If enabled, Monsters (hostile entities) will be hidden based on configured distance limit
chloride.options.culling.monster.distanc: Hides and does not tick monsters beyond this many blocks. Huge performance increase, especially around XP farms.
Hides and does not tick monsters underneath this many blocks, improving performance above caves. This should ideally be set lower than the horizontal distance.
chloride.options.culling.tiles.title: Use max Block Entity Distance
chloride.options.culling.tiles.desc: If enabled, Block Entities will be hidden based on configured distance limit
chloride.options.culling.tile.distance.h: Hides block entities beyond this many blocks. Huge performance increase, especially around lots of modded machines.
chloride.options.culling.tile.distance.v: Hides block entities underneath this many blocks, improving performance above caves (if you have your machines in caves, for some reason). This should ideally be set lower than the horizontal distance.
chloride.options.darkness.mode.title: Darkness Mode
chloride.options.darkness.mode.desc:
Makes the rest of the world more realistically dark. Does not effect daytime or torch light.
Controls how dark is considered true darkness.
chloride.options.darkness.others.title: Enable in Other dimensions
chloride.options.darkness.others.desc:
If enabled, true darkness will be applied in other dimensions

[WARNING] This option will be removed in a near future in favor of a blacklist
chloride.options.darkness.overworld.desc: If enabled, true darkness will be applied in the Overworld.
chloride.options.darkness.noskylight.des: If enabled, true darkness will be applied on dimensions without skylight
chloride.options.darkness.nether.title: Enable on Nether
chloride.options.darkness.nether.desc: If enabled, true darkness will be applied in the Nether.
chloride.options.darkness.nether.brightn: Configure fog brightness in the Nether when darkness is enabled.
chloride.options.darkness.end.title: Enable on End
chloride.options.darkness.end.desc: If enabled, true darkness will be applied in the End.
chloride.options.darkness.end.brightness: Configure fog brightness in the End when darkness is enabled.
chloride.options.darkness.blocklightonly: If enabled, Disables sky, fog and moon brightness, making blocks as a only source of light
chloride.options.darkness.moonphase.desc: If enabled, Darkness will be affected by Moon Phases
chloride.options.darkness.moonphase.fres: Configure brightness on a new moon, or minimal bright level on black moon phase
chloride.options.darkness.moonphase.full: Configure brightness on a full moon, or maximum bright level on black moon phase
chloride.options.dynlights.tiles.title: Use for Block Entities
chloride.options.dynlights.tiles.desc:
If enabled, dynamic lighting will be showed on tile entities (furnaces, modded machines, etc).

This can drastically increase the amount of lighting updates, even when you're not around furnaces
chloride.options.dynlights.entities.desc:
If enabled, dynamic lighting will be showed on entities (dropped items, mobs, etc).

This can drastically increase the amount of lighting updates, even when you're not holding a torch.
chloride.options.dynlights.speed.title: Light Updates Speed
chloride.options.dynlights.speed.desc:
Controls how often dynamic lights will update.

Lighting recalculation can be expensive, so slower values will give better performance.
chloride.options.fadein.title: Chunk Fade In Quality
chloride.options.fadein.desc: Controls how fast chunks fade in. No performance hit, Fancy simply takes longer, but looks a bit cooler. Currently not working
chloride.options.leaves_culling.title: Leaves Culling
chloride.options.leaves_culling.desc: Reduces the number of leaves visible faces of the same type, Controls the depth of the culling
chloride.options.fastchest.title: Use Fast Chests
chloride.options.fastchest.desc:
If enabled, replaces chests model with a static model, like a normal block. Breaks chest animation but goes more faster on chest rooms

Option has no effects with flywheel installed and running batching or instancing backend
IMPORTANT: enabling/disabling it requires also enabling/disabling resourcepack
chloride.options.fastbeds.title: Use Fast Beds
chloride.options.fastbeds.desc:
If enabled, replaces dynamic bed model with a static model, like a normal block. Increases performance and also let you use custom models with resource packs
IMPORTANT: enabling/disabling it requires also enabling/disabling resourcepack
chloride.options.fog.title: Use Fog
chloride.options.fog.desc: If disabled, removed fog effect only in the overworld
chloride.options.blueband.title: Use Sky Blue band
chloride.options.blueband.desc: If disabled, removed the Blue Band effect in all dimensions
chloride.options.fontshadow.title: Font Shadows
chloride.options.fontshadow.desc:
If disabled, text will stop rendering shadows giving a flat style.
Increases FPS depending of how much text is on the screen, specially with BetterF3 mods
chloride.options.jei.title: Hide JEI/REI/EMI Until Searching
chloride.options.jei.desc: If enabled, JEI/REI/EMI item list will be hidden unless you search for something. Press space to search for everything.
chloride.options.screen.title: Fullscreen Mode
chloride.options.screen.desc:
Windowed - the game will display in a small window.
Borderless - the game will be fullscreened, and locked to your monitor's refresh rate, but allow you to tab out easily.
Fullscreen - the game will display in native fullscreen mode.
_____comment: zume translations will be re/moved officially to ZUME
chloride.options.zoom.title: Enable Zume
chloride.options.zoom.desc:
If `true`, the mod will be disabled (on some platforms, key binds will still show in game options; they won't do anything if this is set to `true`).
Requires re-launch to take effect.
chloride.options.zoom.cinematic.title: Cinematic Zoom
chloride.options.zoom.cinematic.desc:
Enable Cinematic Camera while zooming.
If you disable this, you should also try setting `zoomSmoothnessMs` to `0`
chloride.options.zoom.sensitive.title: Mouse Sensitive Floor
chloride.options.zoom.sensitive.desc:
Mouse Sensitivity will not be reduced below this amount while zoomed in.
Set to `1.0` to prevent it from being changed at all (not recommended without `enableCinematicZoom`).
chloride.options.zoom.speed.title: Zoom Speed
chloride.options.zoom.speed.desc:
Speed for Zoom In/Out key binds & zoom scrolling (if enabled).
DEFAULT: `20`
chloride.options.zoom.scrolling.title: Zoom Scrolling
chloride.options.zoom.scrolling.desc:
Allows you to zoom in and out by scrolling up and down on your mouse while zoom is active.
This will prevent you from scrolling through your hotbar while zooming if enabled.
chloride.options.zoom.smoothness.title: Zoom Smoothness
chloride.options.zoom.smoothness.desc:
FOV changes will be spread out over this many milliseconds.
Set to `0` to disable animations.
chloride.options.zoom.easing_exponent.an:
The exponent used for easing animations.
You should probably leave this at the default if you don't understand what it does.
chloride.options.zoom.easing_exponent.zo:
The exponent used for making differences in FOV more uniform.
You should probably leave this at the default if you don't understand what it does.
chloride.options.zoom.default.title: Default Zoom
chloride.options.zoom.toggle.title: Toggle Mode
chloride.options.zoom.toggle.desc:
If `true`, the Zoom keybind will act as a toggle in first-person.
If `false`, Zoom will only be active in first-person while the keybind is held.
chloride.options.zoom.toggle.third_perso:
If `true`, the Zoom keybind will act as a toggle in third-person.
If `false`, Zoom will only be active in third-person while the keybind is held.
chloride.options.zoom.max.title: Maximum FOV
chloride.options.zoom.min.title: Minimum FOV
chloride.options.zoom.third_person.min.d:
Minimum third-person zoom distance (in blocks).
Set to `4.0` to mimic vanilla.
chloride.options.zoom.third_person.max.d:
Maximum third-person zoom distance (in blocks).
Set to `0.0` to disable third-person zoom.
chloride.options.others.borderless.attac:
Configures how Borderless Fullscreen should be attached

ATTACH - Adds it between windowed and Fullscreen
REPLACE - Replaced Fullscreen with Borderless Fullscreen
OFF - Disables Borderless Fullscreen attachment to F11 key
chloride.options.others.languagescreen.f: If enabled, Language updates only reload language instead of all resources, a 99.9% extra of speed
